items.title: S2 Ep5: All About Creativity with SEGA | Francis Hart
items.author: Advancing Analytics
items.summary: Can you use data to make better video games without taking the creativity out of them? This week, Francis Hart, VP of Data & AI at SEGA Europe, is in the hotseat! With host Paul McComish, they chat about how SEGA uses Databricks and AI to understand its players, manage massive amounts of gameplay data and make smarter decisions. Plus, they explore what happens when AI meets creativity, and whether data can really tell us what makes a game fun.

items.title: SQL Server Performance Office Hours Episode 96
items.author: Erik Darling (Erik Darling Data)
items.summary:
In this belated Office Hours (travel delays kept me away for 10 or 11 days after PASS Summit West), I answer five questions: why replacing WHERE EXISTS semi-joins with CROSS APPLY can be so effective for query tuning, the last time I used sp_tableoption, how to design indexing strategies that scale as data grows, why SQL Server sometimes behaves irrationally under pressure, and the hardest performance problems I've ever debugged, which for me are usually parallelism problems that are hard to reproduce. If you have a question for a future episode, the link to submit it is in the video description too.

CHAPTERS

00:00:00 - Introduction
00:06:46 - Replacing EXISTS Semi-Joins With CROSS APPLY
00:07:58 - The Last Time I Used sp_tableoption
00:08:37 - Indexing Strategies That Scale as Data Grows
00:11:34 - Why SQL Server Behaves Irrationally Under Pressure
00:13:04 - The Hardest Performance Problems I've Debugged
00:16:14 - Wrap-Up
